The weighted campus energy balance calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the core logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the single test case in test_output.py using pytest 8.4.1. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighting factors to ensure stability across diverse campus profiles. The results were successfully serialized to result.json with zero exceptions recorded during the trial.
